description:
About our brand and products:

Lunex Hearing offers FDA-registered over-the-counter hearing aids designed for adults experiencing mild to moderate hearing loss. Our affordable, rechargeable devices help seniors and adults reclaim their hearing without a prescription, audiologist visit, or insurance hassle. We offer multiple styles to fit different lifestyles and budgets, all backed by our satisfaction guarantee.

What makes us different:

Unlike traditional hearing aids that cost thousands of dollars through a clinic, Lunex Hearing makes professional-grade hearing technology accessible and affordable for everyone. Our OTC hearing aids are FDA-registered, easy to set up right out of the box, and come with dedicated customer support to ensure every customer gets the most out of their device. We serve a rapidly growing market of 48 million Americans with hearing loss who are actively looking for affordable solutions.

How affiliates can earn:

Earn 14% commission on every sale you refer with a 30-day cookie window. That means if someone clicks your link today and purchases within 30 days, you get paid. Payouts are sent weekly so you never wait long for your earnings. There is no cap on how much you can earn — the more you refer, the more you make.

How to promote us:

  • YouTube reviews and unboxing videos with your referral link in the description
  • Social media posts on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok targeting adults 45 and older
  • Blog articles comparing OTC hearing aids with a CTA and referral link to our landing page
  • Email newsletters to your audience with your unique affiliate link
  • Pinterest boards and Facebook Groups focused on senior health, hearing loss, and affordable healthcare

Other information:

Our program is open to affiliates worldwide with no regional restrictions. Applications are reviewed manually to ensure brand fit. We welcome health bloggers, senior lifestyle creators, audiologists, caregivers, and anyone with an audience interested in affordable hearing solutions. For questions about your application or partnership opportunities, contact us through your affiliate dashboard.
payout_period: Affiliates are paid every week, no waiting for monthly cycles.
